edits.old: Then the decision record and the case-move answer are each written at most once and the repeat is counted
edits.new:
Then the decision record and the case-move answer are each written at most once and the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC11 A consumed call fails or does not answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed contract of the enforcement step does not answer inside 2 s or its breaker is open
    When the enforcement step calls the consumed contract
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's own schedule, nothing is written, no case move is answered and the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC12 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the legal action is already CLOSED or WITHDRAWN, or is not the action type the rule needs
    When the enforcement step is started on that legal action
    Then the answer is 409, nothing changes and the match is not evaluated again
